wl_03571.例句JSON: [{"hanzi":"老人拄杖走路，险些仆倒在地。","pinyin":"lǎo rén zhǔ zhàng zǒu lù, xiǎn xiē pū dǎo zài dì.","english":"The old man walks with a stick and nearly falls.","chunks":[{"hanzi":"老人","pinyin":"lǎo rén","gloss":"old man"},{"hanzi":"拄杖","pinyin":"zhǔ zhàng","gloss":"lean on a walking stick"},{"hanzi":"走路，","pinyin":"zǒu lù,","gloss":"walk"},{"hanzi":"险些","pinyin":"xiǎn xiē","gloss":"almost"},{"hanzi":"仆倒","pinyin":"pū dǎo","gloss":"fall"},{"hanzi":"在","pinyin":"zài","gloss":"on"},{"hanzi":"地。","pinyin":"dì.","gloss":"ground"}]},{"hanzi":"他脚下一滑，仆倒在雪地里。","pinyin":"tā jiǎo xià yì huá, pū dǎo zài xuě dì lǐ.","english":"His foot slips and he falls forward into the snow.","chunks":[{"hanzi":"他","pinyin":"tā","gloss":"he"},{"hanzi":"脚下","pinyin":"jiǎo xià","gloss":"under the foot"},{"hanzi":"一滑，","pinyin":"yì huá,","gloss":"slips"},{"hanzi":"仆倒","pinyin":"pū dǎo","gloss":"fall forward or collapse"},{"hanzi":"在","pinyin":"zài","gloss":"at; be doing"},{"hanzi":"雪地","pinyin":"xuě dì","gloss":"snow-covered ground"},{"hanzi":"里。","pinyin":"lǐ.","gloss":"in; inside"}]}]
